name: sp-bridge
description: Small headless agent that serves Super Productivity's local REST API and syncs to a SuperSync server
//dependencies: Intentionally none. The agent type-checks and bundles Super Productivity's own sources (src/app/**) and the workspace packages (packages/*), so it needs the REPO's dependencies — Angular, NgRx, typia, zod, rxjs and the rest — not a hand-copied subset of them. Those come from the root `npm ci`, exactly as they do for the app. An earlier version declared copies here; it drifted immediately and would have shadowed the root's canonical Angular types with a second, divergent copy in CI.
//devDependencies: Build and packaging tooling only. esbuild bundles; typescript + @types/node back the typecheck script; electron/electron-builder produce the Windows installer; prettier formats. `tsc` and `esbuild` must be declared here because neither resolves from the agent directory otherwise, and a clean CI checkout has no ancestor install to fall back on.
